title: Noor and the Thorn
premise: Juniper Thackeray has survived three years as a royal food-taster in Vellamere, a city where magic is outlawed and she secretly sells charms to feed her found family of fellow servants. When a dying hedge-wizard presses a map into her hands, she discovers she is heir to the Thorn Covenant, the broken pact that once kept the fae realm from bleeding into the mortal one, and that the king's poisonings are no accident but a campaign to sever the realms forever. Hunted by the royal spymaster who trained her, Juniper must gather the scattered covenant-bearers — including Noor, a fae knight bound by duty to kill any heir who refuses the covenant's price. In the end, Juniper reforges the covenant not with blood sacrifice as tradition demands, but by offering shared rule, binding herself and Noor together as its living heart while her found family holds the city gates against the king's final purge.
about_author: Astrid Ashgrove is the pen name of a former line cook who swears the kitchen taught her more about poison and politics than any library could. She writes fantasy about people who inherit burdens they never asked for, usually while holding something hot.

chapters.title: The Taster's Tongue
chapters.summary: POV Juniper. A routine tasting at court nearly kills her, revealing the king is being slowly poisoned by something magical. She pockets a residue sample, terrified, and returns to the tenement where her found family waits. Beat: quiet dread beneath daily survival.

chapters.title: Charms for Copper
chapters.summary: POV Juniper. In the night market, Juniper sells small protective charms despite the magic ban, showing her network of buyers and the spymaster Wren Corliss watching from shadows. A stranger in grey watches her too. Beat: defiance laced with fear.

chapters.title: The Dying Stranger
chapters.summary: POV Juniper. The grey-cloaked man collapses at her stall, pressing a bloodstained map into her hands and whispering 'Thorn-heir' before dying of wounds that burn like frost. Guards converge; she flees with the map. Beat: shock, unwanted inheritance.

chapters.title: What the Map Shows
chapters.summary: POV Juniper. Hidden in the tenement, Juniper and her family decipher the map: seven covenant-stones across two realms, one already dark. The dead man's frost-wounds match the poison at court. Beat: reluctant commitment as the stakes connect.

chapters.title: Wren Corliss Knows
chapters.summary: POV Wren. The spymaster interrogates witnesses, recognizing Juniper's handiwork in the market charms he's tolerated for years. Ordered to find the map, he struggles between duty to a rotting crown and fondness for the girl he once mentored. Beat: loyalty cracking.

chapters.title: The First Stone
chapters.summary: POV Juniper. Fleeing the city through the sewers with her friend Tam, Juniper reaches the first covenant-stone and touches it — it flares alive, naming her heir. Something on the other side notices. Beat: awe turning to terror.

chapters.title: Noor
chapters.summary: POV Noor. A fae knight of the Bramble Court steps through the half-open stone under orders: kill any false heir, or bind them to the covenant's price. Finding Juniper, Noor hesitates — she smells of the old magic, of home. Beat: duty versus recognition.

chapters.title: An Uneasy Bargain
chapters.summary: POV Juniper. Noor offers escort instead of execution, claiming he must verify her claim before the Court judges. Neither trusts the other. They travel toward the second stone while Wren's hunters close in behind. Beat: prickly alliance, sparks of respect.

chapters.title: The Poisoner's Trail
chapters.summary: POV Wren. Following the frost-poison to its source, Wren finds the king's own alchemist, who confesses the court is deliberately severing the realms to seize their magic. Wren burns the confession rather than deliver it. Beat: open betrayal of his masters.

chapters.title: The Second Stone
chapters.summary: POV Juniper. At a drowned chapel, the second stone demands a memory as toll. Juniper gives up her mother's face, grieving, while Noor reveals fragments of what the covenant's original price truly was. Beat: cost made personal.

chapters.title: Hunted Across the Marches
chapters.summary: POV Noor. Royal hunters with iron-forged weapons ambush them; Noor takes a wound that won't heal in mortal lands. Juniper saves him with a charm she never thought would matter. Beat: trust forged in blood.

chapters.title: The Family That Follows
chapters.summary: POV Tam. Juniper's found family abandons the tenement, pursued by Wren's agents, and catches up to bring supplies and stubborn loyalty. Tam confronts Juniper about lying to protect them. Beat: found family tested and reaffirmed.

chapters.title: The Bramble Court
chapters.summary: POV Noor. Crossing into the fae realm, they reach the Bramble Court, where the Queen reveals the truth: the covenant requires an heir's life freely given, and Noor was sent to ensure it. Juniper refuses to die for a realm that abandoned hers. Beat: betrayal within the sanctuary.

chapters.title: Flight From Two Courts
chapters.summary: POV Juniper. Branded oath-breakers in both realms, they flee the Court with the Queen's hunters behind and Wren's ahead. Noor chooses exile, cutting his own oath-thread. Beat: love against duty, chosen openly.

chapters.title: Wren's Choice
chapters.summary: POV Wren. Wren intercepts them — and instead of arresting Juniper, hands over the alchemist's evidence and his resignation in the same breath. The king's purge of the city begins without him. Beat: redemption at personal ruin.

chapters.title: The Siege of Vellamere
chapters.summary: POV Tam. Back in the city, the found family organizes the charm-sellers and servants into resistance as royal soldiers seal the gates. Tam sends word to Juniper: come home, we'll hold the door. Beat: ordinary people becoming extraordinary.

chapters.title: The Fifth and Sixth Stones
chapters.summary: POV Juniper. Racing the collapsing boundary between realms, Juniper and Noor light two stones in a single desperate night, each toll taking more of her — years, warmth, name. Noor begins giving pieces of himself instead. Beat: sacrifice shared.

chapters.title: The King's Last Dish
chapters.summary: POV Juniper. Summoned to court under truce, Juniper tastes the king's final banquet and recognizes the frost-poison's true purpose: to kill the land itself so the covenant dies unclaimed. She exposes the alchemist publicly. Beat: the taster's skill becomes her weapon.

chapters.title: What the Covenant Asks
chapters.summary: POV Noor. At the seventh stone, the full price stands revealed: one life, freely given, forever bound. Noor moves to give his own; Juniper stops him. Together they propose what no court imagined — two lives, willingly intertwined, ruling jointly. Beat: rewriting the terms.

chapters.title: The Reforging
chapters.summary: POV Juniper. The seventh stone accepts the new covenant: Juniper and Noor bound as its living heart, neither realm ruling the other. Magic returns lawfully to Vellamere as the stones blaze in a chain of light. Beat: climax — love and duty reconciled.

chapters.title: After the Purge
chapters.summary: POV Wren. With the king deposed by his own exposed crimes, Wren helps rebuild, teaching the new covenant-law alongside the very charm-sellers he once hunted. He visits the first stone and leaves flowers for the grey-cloaked stranger. Beat: grief transmuted into service.

chapters.title: Noor and the Thorn
chapters.summary: POV Juniper. One year later, Juniper runs a legal charm-shop above the tenement, her family around her, Noor learning to cook badly. The thorn-mark on her wrist pulses warm when the realms breathe easy. Beat: resolution — inheritance transformed into belonging.
